svg.title: Professional Narrative — Jeya Stephen
svg.text: WHO I AM & WHAT I BUILD

text.tspan: I am an AI/ML Engineer and Full-Stack Developer completing a B.Tech in Artificial
Intelligence and Data Science at Ramco Institute of Technology. My work spans the
continuum from model training and computer vision pipelines to end-to-end full-stack architectures —
building resilient systems that perceive, reason, and act.
I focus on production-ready engineering: real-time object detection systems, speech-driven healthcare
assistants, LLM-powered SaaS automations, and scalable MERN microservices. I care equally about
algorithmic precision, system latency, and crafted user experience.

g.text: Computer Vision (YOLOv8, OpenCV) · LLM Pipelines · MERN
